name: monkey-brain
description: The Monkey Brain — a compounding LLM-wiki knowledge engine for any project or product

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Per-project .brain/ knowledge engine: budgeted session context injection, an enforced knowledge SDLC (ingest / query / lint / wrap), token discipline with receipts, and compounding domain expertise packs. Ships with five capability plugins from the official marketplace.

plugins.name: brain-all
plugins.displayName: The Monkey Brain — every official plugin
plugins.description: Opt-in bundle: one install pulls in brain plus every plugin in Anthropic's official marketplace (except the output styles that contradict terse mode). Heavy by design — each enabled plugin adds context every turn; service connectors still need your own login, LSP plugins their language binaries.
